# apipbx_firewall_rule (Resource)

An extra accept, drop or reject rule, which runs before the services. A drop or reject that would block the caller from SSH or the API is refused: to let only some addresses in, use apipbx_firewall_restriction. apipbxd has no way to change a rule, so every attribute forces a replacement. Import with the rule id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) accept, drop or reject.

### Optional

- `comment` (String)
- `port` (String) A port such as 5060 or a range such as 10000-20000; empty is every port.
- `protocol` (String) tcp, udp or any (a port needs tcp or udp).
- `sources` (Set of String) Addresses or CIDR ranges; empty is from anywhere.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
